title: Quadratic formal curve and coefficient algebra
statement: Let $F$ be a field and $a,b,c\in F$. Define $p=aZ^2+bZ+c\in F[Z]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] and $q=aX^2+bXY+cY^2\in F[[X,Y]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Define the $F$-algebras $L=F[Z]/(p)$ and $R=F[[X,Y]]/(q)$ using the principal-ideal quotient [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Write $x,y\in R$ for the classes of $X,Y$ respectively. These constructions are defined for every $a,b,c$, without nondegeneracy hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 0C4A (lemma-2-branches-delta-1), proof, Cases I and II with X,Y interchanged in Case II; Tag 0CBT (remark-quadratic-extension), construction (1).
